value.syntax: # [doc = " Read-only whole-act inputs for the later graph partition."] # [doc = " (´def:acts:boundary-inputs´)"] # [derive (Debug)] pub struct BoundaryInputs < 'a > { # [doc = " Node visits, parent inspections, inherited-member insert attempts and emitted members."] # [doc = " None means counter overflow, never a work-limit refusal."] work : Option < u64 > , # [doc = " Fixed pre-epoch cut: history lies before it and proposals at or after it."] boundary : Position , # [doc = " Union of all closures, each whole act carried once in authoritative order."] acts : Vec < & 'a ValidatedAct > , # [doc = " Overlap is retained; no connected components or disjoint blocks are computed."] closures : Vec < PrincipalClosure > , }
